name: The Joseph Nashville
positioning: Art-filled luxury hotel in downtown Nashville, officially The Joseph, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Nashville, with a rooftop saltwater pool and a spa 21 floors up
best_for: Art lovers who want a downtown base two blocks from Broadway
Travelers who want a rooftop pool and spa in the city

facts.text: The Joseph is at 401 Korean Veterans Boulevard in downtown Nashville.
Broadway's live music venues are a two-block walk from the hotel, and the Grand Ole Opry is a short drive.
The hotel's developers, the Pizzuti family, are art collectors who share their collection at The Joseph.
Each room has at least one print from the Joseph Editions' Tennessee Portfolio, featuring artists with a connection to the state.
Rooms and suites use a design palette of copper, oak, warm marble and brown leather, with marble bathrooms.
Room pillows feature chain stitch embroidery in the style of Nudie Suits.
Suites have a curated selection of vinyl albums to play on Audio-Technica turntables with Bose speakers.
The rooftop pool has lounge seating and luxury cabanas.
Rose spa has deluxe steam rooms, Experience Showers and a co-ed Relaxation Lounge.
The Fitness Studio is exclusively for hotel guests and has Peloton bikes and weight training equipment.
Denim is a poolside rooftop bar.

highlights.text: The hotel displays more than 1,100 pieces of rare art.
The rooftop pool is an Italian-made saltwater pool.
Rose, the hotel's spa and salon, sits 21 floors above the city streets.
The Presidential Suite has an Italian marble bar and a fully restored 1920s-era Steinway Salon Grand piano.
The 8th-floor gallery shows photographs from Alec Soth's Songbook series and has a terrace overlooking the city.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Advance spa reservations are highly recommended, and appointments within 4-6 weeks are limited.
WhataHotel notes potential street noise from the downtown setting.
